description:
Welcome to my channel! I'm Lelac, aka BaoChickaWowWow, and this is officially my FIRST video, and I'm starting with South Park: The Stick of Truth. I'd heard great things about it and it's giving me major Lord of the Rings vibes.

In Part 1 I move to South Park as the New Kid, make my first friend (Butters), join Cartman's kingdom at Kupa Keep, get named something I can't repeat, learn to fight, and watch the Stick of Truth get stolen right out from under us.

Should I keep going with this series? Let me know in the comments!

If you enjoyed it, like and subscribe so you don't miss Part 2.

thumbnails:
Times are in the EDITED video (raw-stream time in brackets). Pause there and screenshot, or ask me to export full-res PNGs.
Style both reference channels use: one huge face reaction + one big game element + 2-4 words max. Push saturation, add a thick outline around you and the character.

1. "HE CALLED ME WHAT?!"  (best fit for title #1)
   - Your face: 12:02 [13:23] laughing in disbelief, or 12:23 [13:45] hand-over-mouth laugh
   - Game: Cartman in his wizard hat at 11:38 [13:00] (cut him out and make him big on the right)
   - Text: "DOUCHEBAG?!" or "HE CALLED ME WHAT"
   - Avoid the class-select cards at 11:55 [13:17] (the card on screen there can get thumbnails flagged)

2. "THE STICK OF TRUTH"  (clean, series-branding look you can reuse every episode)
   - Game: the glowing Stick on its pedestal at 18:38 [20:32] (the spotlight looks great)
   - Your face: an excited or shocked frame from 0:07 [0:30] (big smile, facing the camera)
   - Text: "EP. 1" in the corner and the game logo from the title screen at 0:07
   - This is the safest, most "series" style. Keep the layout the same each episode and change only the face and the moment.

3. "CLYDE HAD ONE JOB"
   - Game: Cartman yelling at Clyde, 24:34 [27:31] or 24:47 [27:44] (whole army in frame)
   - Your face: shocked or open mouth (any frame from 24:30-24:50)
   - Text: "THEY STOLE IT" or "ONE JOB."
   - Add a red arrow pointing at the empty pedestal or Clyde.

4. "CARTMAN'S ROOM IS..."  (highest curiosity, but riskiest)
   - Game: Cartman's bedroom at 30:11 [34:03]
   - Note: the bong is in shot. Fine for viewers, but drug imagery in a thumbnail can limit ads, so blur it or crop it out.
   - Text: "CARTMAN'S ROOM 👀"

Recommendation: #1 for this episode (matches the strongest moment and title), then the #2 layout as the series template going forward.
